svg.title: October 5: crane, new eastern site office and exposed foundations
svg.text: October 5, 2026 — lifting, excavation and a new site office
1. Crane set up on deployed outriggers and support pads
2. Mobile office on the prepared eastern gravel base
3. Concrete shaft heads exposed by excavation
4. Reinforcement projects above the shaft heads
5. Volvo excavator beside a crushed-stone stockpile
6. Retaining wall along the excavation boundary
7. Approximate near edge of the deep excavation
8. Single-drum roller beside the prepared surface
Office use observer-confirmed. No dimensions or final building line inferred.
